spec.description: Borgmatic backup status for the onion host. Metrics are written by the borgmatic textfile collector and exposed via node_exporter at onion.lc.brotherwolf.ca:9100. Configuration lives in the nixos repo (generic/borgmatic.nix).
End time of the most recent borgmatic archive.
spec.title: Last backup

spec.description: Time since check "data" last passed. Runs yearly on Saturdays (borgmatic.nix frequency 1 year). Gauge scale = 3 cycles: green <1y, orange 1-2y, red >=2y; beyond 3y pegs at full red.
spec.title: Data check

spec.description: Repository size over time. Jumps mark new backup runs.
spec.title: Repository size

spec.description: How much space is saved by deduplication and compression.
spec.title: Deduplication & compression ratio

spec.description: Distinct days holding borgmatic archives, of the keep_daily = 14 target in borgmatic.nix. Full gauge = retention target; red <5, orange 5-9, green >=10.
spec.title: Days

spec.description: Distinct ISO weeks holding borgmatic archives, of the keep_weekly = 10 target in borgmatic.nix. Full gauge = retention target; red <3, orange 3-6, green >=7.
spec.title: Weeks

spec.description: Distinct years holding borgmatic archives, of the keep_yearly = 4 target in borgmatic.nix. Full gauge = retention target; red 0, orange 1, green >=2.
spec.title: Years

spec.description: Share of the repository that deduplication eliminates (1 − deduped/total).
spec.title: Space saved by deduplication

spec.description: Space on the backup drive holding the borg repository (/run/media/daniel/stb, btrfs on /dev/mapper/backup, 4 TB). The gap between used and capacity is backup headroom; the repo line is what borg occupies on disk (deduplicated).
spec.title: Backup drive space (stb)

spec.description: Share of the backup drive (btrfs /dev/mapper/backup at /run/media/daniel/stb) in use. Repo storage headroom: warn >=75%, critical >=90%.
spec.title: Backup drive usage

spec.description: Free headroom on the backup drive (/run/media/daniel/stb). Red <200 GB, orange 200-500 GB, green >500 GB.
spec.title: Free space (stb)

spec.description: Freshness of the last successful backup (0 if none yet). Colours: green fresh, orange >26h, red >3d.
spec.title: Time since last backup

spec.description: Distinct months holding borgmatic archives, of the keep_monthly = 12 target in borgmatic.nix. Full gauge = retention target; red <3, orange 3-6, green >=8.
spec.title: Months

spec.description: Wall-clock duration of the most recent archive.
spec.title: Duration of last backup

spec.description: Archives created by borgmatic (borgmatic_<hostname>_* prefix).
spec.title: borgmatic archives

spec.description: All archives in the repository, including non-borgmatic prefixes.
spec.title: Repository archives

spec.description: Time since check "archives" last passed. Runs daily (borgmatic.nix frequency 1 day). Gauge scale = 3 cycles: green <1d, orange 1-2d, red >=2d; beyond 3d pegs at full red.
spec.title: Archives check

spec.description: Time since check "repository" last passed. Runs monthly on Saturdays (borgmatic.nix frequency 1 month). Gauge scale = 3 cycles: green <30d, orange 30-60d, red >=60d; beyond 90d pegs at full red.
spec.title: Repository check

spec.description: Time since check "spot" last passed. Runs every 2 months on Sundays (0.1% count / 1% data tolerance). Gauge scale = 3 cycles: green <60d, orange 60-120d, red >=120d; beyond 180d pegs at full red.
spec.title: Spot check

spec.description: Time since check "extract" last passed. Runs yearly on Sundays (borgmatic.nix frequency 1 year). Gauge scale = 3 cycles: green <1y, orange 1-2y, red >=2y; beyond 3y pegs at full red.
spec.title: Extract check
